module Demo.Greeter

open System

(* outer (* nested *) still a comment *)
type Shape =
    | Circle of radius: float
    | Rect of width: float * height: float

let area shape =
    match shape with
    | Circle r -> Math.PI * r * r
    | Rect (w, h) -> w * h

let greet (name: string) (times: int) : string =
    let text = sprintf "Hello, %s!\n" name
    let path = @"C:\temp\""quoted"""
    let raw = """Raw "text" \n stays"""
    let interp = $"Name: {name}, times: {times}"
    let c = 'x'
    if times > 0 && not (String.IsNullOrEmpty name) then String.replicate times text
    else failwith "bad"

[<EntryPoint>]
let main argv =
    printfn "%s %f %d" (greet "world" 2) (area (Circle 1.5)) 0x1F
    let opt = Some 42 |> Option.map (fun x -> x + 1_000)
    0
